cause: Both item controllers only cast their form when five stacks are present and the owner is out of combat. They never removed the infinite form after the speed buff expired or lost stacks, and had no controller-removal cleanup.

HandleAuraModShapeshift's resource switch omitted valid Spirit Owl 37/38 and Wisp 40. It logged an unknown-form error but continued through the common model code. This diagnostic omission was distinct from the missing form lifetime cleanup; silencing the message alone would not repair expiry.
implementation: A shared updater removes only the relevant item's form when its speed aura is missing or below five stacks, the aura owner enters combat, or the owner is dead. This runs on the native 500ms controller tick, so normal expiry cleanup is bounded by the next tick rather than claiming an exact same-frame removal.
Existing form/other shapeshift checks retain one-time application and do not replace another active form. No kill/proc/credit, speed-stack, flight-area, movement, mount or pet code was changed.
Both controllers use GetUnitOwner and bind AfterEffectRemove to clean their own form when the item/controller is removed, including when its caster cannot resolve.

Admit all four native legendary travel forms through the existing neutral-resource branch. Common form/model restoration, boosts, temporary spells and InitDataForForm remain in use; truly unknown types still log their error.
